(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination, wherein the steps are performed by a user without reliance on any additional tools.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, and the second quantity being applied manually by the user with the finger palette.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom that would hinder cleaning or application of cosmetic product.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar and free of features that could trap cosmetics and complicate cleaning of the surface portion.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 further including the step of securing the finger palette to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion without requiring additional fastening mechanisms.
